WITH site_ratios AS (
  SELECT 
    s.zoneregistry,
    s.insurstat,
    AVG(CAST(sm.facetresmm AS REAL) / CAST(sm.geomdeltamm AS REAL)) as site_ratio
  FROM sites s
  LEFT JOIN scanmesh sm ON s.zoneregistry = sm.zoneref
  WHERE sm.facetresmm IS NOT NULL 
    AND sm.geomdeltamm IS NOT NULL 
    AND sm.geomdeltamm != 0 
    AND s.insurstat IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
),
status_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    insurstat, 
    AVG(site_ratio) as status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_ratios
  GROUP BY insurstat
),
kept_sites AS (
  SELECT 
    sr.insurstat,
    sr.zoneregistry,
    sr.site_ratio,
    sa.status_avg_ratio
  FROM site_ratios sr
  JOIN status_averages sa ON sr.insurstat = sa.insurstat
  WHERE sr.site_ratio > sa.status_avg_ratio
)
SELECT 
  insurstat,
  AVG(site_ratio) as avg_ratio_kept_sites,
  COUNT(DISTINCT zoneregistry) as num_kept_sites,
  AVG(site_ratio - status_avg_ratio) as avg_excess
FROM kept_sites
GROUP BY insurstat
